note: ARES Phase 3 source records. 'verified' means ARES opened the page on the checkedOn date and confirmed the stated facts. Nothing here is a citation we have not read.

jpl-boxwork.title: NASA's Curiosity Rover Sees Martian 'Spiderwebs' Up Close
jpl-boxwork.supports: Boxwork ridges roughly 1 to 2 m tall with sandy hollows; the groundwater-and-minerals explanation is a proposal; central fractures confirmed up close; nodules found on ridge walls and in hollows, not near fractures; clay found in a ridge sample and carbonate in a hollow sample.
jpl-boxwork.limits: News article, not a peer-reviewed paper. Gives no map coordinates. Does not give a drill-site name for the ridge or hollow samples.

jpl-boxwork-2025.title: NASA's Curiosity Mars Rover Starts Unpacking Boxwork Formations
jpl-boxwork-2025.supports: First close-up views of boxwork; patterns extend for miles on Mount Sharp and were not seen elsewhere on the mountain; bedrock between ridges differs in composition and has calcium sulfate veins; the rock Altadena was drilled on 8 June 2025.
jpl-boxwork-2025.limits: News article, not a peer-reviewed paper. Says some ridges are 'just a few inches tall', which differs from the 1 to 2 m in the 2026 article. Gives no coordinates.

pia26552.title: PIA26552: Curiosity on the Road to Boxwork Formations
pia26552.supports: Mastcam panorama taken 9 March 2025 (sol 4476) showing the butte nicknamed Gould Mesa, whose dark ridges and cliff band may be the first glimpses of boxwork.
pia26552.limits: The page's search-engine description says 18 Nov 2020 (sol 2946), which conflicts with the page text (9 March 2025, sol 4476). ARES uses the page text. Gives no coordinates.

pia26697.title: PIA26697: Curiosity Studies Nodules on Boxwork Formations
pia26697.supports: MAHLI mosaic of 50 images taken 21 Aug 2025 (sol 4636); nodules found along ridge walls and in hollows; wavy ridges between nodule groups are calcium sulfate veins.
pia26697.limits: Does not state where on the map the image was taken.

hughes2022.limits: ARES has not opened this paper. Do not treat any ARES claim as supported by it until it is checked.
